propositions: Exact summary mutations must route through legacy-default selector and bypass generic retry when test-enabled, while mixed-field mutations remain on legacy call path without dual-send.
Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) must map to legacy result surface with derived summary value from mutation's fields["summary"] and advance baseline/provenance.

Terminal dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and others) must emit single redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points without advancing baseline or persisting deferral.
Constructor-injected selector defaults to legacy, adds no config/environment key, and includes defensive no-op mapping for already_satisfied despite no current emission.
S3 named as sole production cutover owner, fuse/deferral consumer, and compatibility-bridge retirement owner in ADR 0103.
